findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sales_conversation, due_diligence · Public sink: sales_conversation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sales_conversation, due_diligence · Public sink: sales_conversation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "site_overview" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Describe this website, who publishes it (Yazılım Koçu, a Turkish software company), its topics and the other sites in the network. Call this first when you need context about the site." → after: "Describe this website, who publishes it (Yazılım Koçu, a founder-led Turkish software studio; legal name and tax ID included), its topics and the other sites in the network. Call this first when you need context about the site."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
